fact: A sketch of 3-D shape in which the measurements of the sides are proportional to their actual lengths is called an isometric sketch. Isometric sketches are drawn on isometric dot sheets.
A solid made up of polygonal regions is called polyhedron.
Polyhedrons that are made up of convex polygons are called convex polyhedrons i.e. polyhedron whose surfaces are convex polygons is called convex polyhedron.
A polyhedron whose base and top are congruent polygons and whose lateral faces are parallelograms in shape is called a prism.
A prism is named after its base, if base is a triangle then it is called a triangular prism. Various types of prisms are given below.
A prism whose base and top are congruent triangles and lateral faces are rectangles is called a triangular prism.
A prism whose base and top are congruent rectangles and lateral faces are rectangles is called a rectangular prism. It is also called a cuboid.
A prism whose base and top are congruent pentagons and lateral faces are rectangles is called a pentagonal prism.
A prism whose base and top are congruent hexagons and lateral faces are rectangles is called a hexagonal prism.
A polyhedron whose base is a polygon (of any number of sides) and whose lateral faces are triangles with a common vertex is called a pyramid.
A pyramid whose base is a triangle is called a triangular pyramid. It is also known as tetrahedron.
A pyramid whose base is a rectangle is called a rectangular pyramid.
A pyramid whose base is a square is called a square pyramid.
A pyramid whose base is a pentagon is called a pentagonal pyramid.
A pyramid whose base is a hexagon is called a hexagonal pyramid.
